name: io.github.jamiew/monarch-mcp
title: Monarch MCP Server
description: Query and update Monarch Money accounts, transactions, and budgets

environmentVariables.name: MONARCH_MFA_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: TOTP secret for 2FA, not a rotating code

environmentVariables.name: MONARCH_FORCE_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to skip the cached session

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: List accounts with balances

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Filter transactions by date, account, category, or pending/posted status

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search by merchant or keyword, optionally pending/posted only

tools.name: get_budgets
tools.description: Get budgets and spending limits

tools.name: get_cashflow
tools.description: Get income and expense totals

tools.name: get_transaction_categories
tools.description: List transaction categories

tools.name: get_transaction_rules
tools.description: Page through compact rules in priority order; verbose details optional

tools.name: get_household_members
tools.description: List household members and IDs for ownership updates

tools.name: create_transaction_rule
tools.description: Create a rule, and optionally run it on past transactions

tools.name: update_transaction_rule
tools.description: Edit a rule, and optionally run it on past transactions

tools.name: delete_transaction_rule
tools.description: Delete a transaction rule

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Create a manual transaction

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Update transaction fields or assign ownership

tools.name: update_transactions_bulk
tools.description: Update fields or owners with per-item results

tools.name: get_transaction_splits
tools.description: Read transaction splits

tools.name: get_transaction_details
tools.description: Resolve split parent and leg IDs before reading or replacing splits

tools.name: update_transaction_splits
tools.description: Replace all splits; an empty list removes them

tools.name: get_account_holdings
tools.description: Get account investment holdings

tools.name: get_all_holdings
tools.description: Get holdings grouped by brokerage account

tools.name: get_account_history
tools.description: Page through account history with inclusive ISO date bounds

tools.name: get_institutions
tools.description: List linked financial institutions

tools.name: get_recurring_transactions
tools.description: Read scheduled occurrences within a date range, not payment status

tools.name: update_recurring_transaction
tools.description: Edit merchant-wide recurrence, not posted transactions

tools.name: set_budget_amount
tools.description: Set a category budget

tools.name: create_manual_account
tools.description: Create a manually tracked account

tools.name: refresh_accounts
tools.description: Request account refresh

tools.name: get_spending_summary
tools.description: Group spending by category, account, or month, excluding transfers

tools.name: get_complete_financial_overview
tools.description: Get compact financial summaries; full sections optional

tools.name: analyze_spending_patterns
tools.description: Summarize trends with compact budgets and optional forecasts

tools.name: get_recurring_streams
tools.description: List every recurring stream with its merchant ID and next forecast

tools.name: get_merchants
tools.description: Page through merchants with transaction and rule counts

tools.name: delete_merchant
tools.description: Delete a merchant, optionally moving its transactions to another merchant

tools.name: get_transaction_tags
tools.description: List household transaction tags

tools.name: create_transaction_tag
tools.description: Create a transaction tag

tools.name: set_transaction_tags
tools.description: Replace a transaction's tags

tools.name: delete_transaction
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction

tools.name: find_duplicate_transactions
tools.description: Find possible duplicate transactions

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Rename an account, set its balance, or change visibility settings

tools.name: get_net_worth_history
tools.description: Daily net worth, or monthly balances by account type

tools.name: get_credit_score_history
tools.description: Household credit score snapshots

tools.name: get_savings_goals
tools.description: List savings goals with targets and progress

tools.name: set_savings_goal_budget_amount
tools.description: Set a goal's planned monthly contribution

securityConsiderations: Unofficial API access requires Monarch credentials with full read/write access. Protect credentials, session tokens, and logs, which may contain financial inputs and error details.
